topic.readerProblem: Calculate contacts, credits, onboarding and first-year HubSpot costs correctly.
topic.connection: Historical adjacent software article retained for existing readers and URL continuity; not a new AEOeye core-topic endorsement or quota item.

assessment: Corrected a unit error that treated a recurring monthly credit-capacity charge as a one-off yearly amount. Separated catalog and annual-payment-discount offers, stored contacts from marketing contacts, and the standalone AEO product from a compulsory full Marketing Hub purchase.

sources.supports: Catalog $0.010/credit or $10/month per 1000 capacity makes 2000 extra per month $20/month=$240/year. $800*12+$3000+$240=$12840 first year. Discounted $9 offer is qualified separately; onboarding and commitment terms are not omitted.

checks: Checked the official product catalog and Marketing Hub pricing source.
Recomputed the corrected credit-capacity example with consistent periods.
Distinguished contacts, credits, standalone AEO and full-hub pricing.
